published_value.explain: Schedule D line 9, column (h), is your long-term Form 8949 box E gain or loss, proceeds minus basis plus adjustments.

computed_zero.explain: Schedule D line 9, column (h), is zero because your box E proceeds, basis, and adjustments net to zero.

closure_backed_zero.explain: Schedule D line 9, column (h), is zero. No long-term sale whose basis was not reported to the IRS is recorded, and your answer about those sales confirms the list is complete.

blocked.explain: Schedule D line 9, column (h), has no value yet. It waits for your answers about sales whose basis was not reported to the IRS, or for a recorded long-term sale of that kind to pass its checks.
